title: KYC Refresh Calendar: Cash Pickup Reliance at a Personal Sender Account Upgrade
content:
When a Personal Sender Account is moved up a level, cash reliance for the refresh interval is the number of Cash Pickup payouts made on the customer's transfers in the 12 months before the upgrade date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting:

| Cash Pickup payouts made in the 12 months before the upgrade date | Months taken off the risk-weighted refresh interval |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 6 |
| at least 4 but fewer than 8 | 3 |
| fewer than 4 | 0 |

When it is 8 or more, 6 months are taken off the risk-weighted refresh interval; when it is at least 4 but fewer than 8, 3 months are taken off; when it is fewer than 4, nothing is taken off for cash reliance.

## What is counted

Each payout made entry in the ledger of one of the customer's Cash Pickup transfers, dated inside the 12 months, is one payout made. Payments, fees and refunds on those transfers are not payouts made, and the amount paid out does not change the count.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

- 3 payouts made: nothing taken off. 4 payouts made: 3 months taken off.
- 7 payouts made: 3 months taken off. 8 payouts made: 6 months taken off.
- Hypothetical dates: for an upgrade on 12 October, a payout made on 13 October of the year before counts; one made on 12 October of the year before no longer counts.
